title_vi: Hạnh phúc và những truyện khác
translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Mansfield’s free indirect shifts of focalisation are kept unsignalled, with dashes and ellipses preserved unspaced, in dry, oblique, sensory Vietnamese.
decisions.rationale: The stories live in these shifts and in what is left unsaid.

decisions.decision: French and Italian phrases stay in the source language; dialect and mis-speech (the landlady, the char, Antonio) are given Vietnamese equivalents.
decisions.rationale: Register is part of the characterisation.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: Mrs. Knight (‘Face’) was written ‘anh’ although she is a woman; now ‘chị’ here and in her later lines.
‘She’ referred to the friendship, but the draft made it the woman; corrected.
The dustpan was rendered as a frying pan (‘chảo’); now ‘hót rác’.
‘Anh’ made the husband the one who ignored the instruction about speed; the driver is meant, and the line now says so.
Face’s self-reference alternated between ‘em’ and ‘chị’ toward Bertha; unified as ‘chị’.
The landlady’s ‘College eddication’ had become ‘trường nhạc’; now a plain, mocking ‘học hành đại học hẳn hoi’.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The nickname stays in English; the address is fixed.
Nicknames rendered as Vietnamese words so the child’s world is audible.
One address system through the story.

glossary.draft_rendering: Hạnh phúc; Gió thổi; Tâm lý; Những bức tranh; Cô gia sư bé nhỏ; Cuộc trốn thoát
glossary.rationale: Titles are translated; Je ne parle pas français and Feuille d’Album stay in French.

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #44385, an electronic transcription of Bliss, and Other Stories by Katherine Mansfield (1920). The Gutenberg page does not name the exact printing and the text was not collated with the first edition.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Mouse’s ‘em’ and the dream-boy’s ‘anh’ shift roles within a few units in Raoul’s dream; left as a deliberate dream blur but flagged.
Quote nesting in units 990 and 1097 is simplified for letters that span several units.

title_review.target_title: Hạnh phúc và những truyện khác
title_review.rationale: The collection title is translated as ‘Hạnh phúc và những truyện khác’; no earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The opening of ‘Prelude’: the buggy with no room for Lottie and Kezia.
